text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Crew member of missing launch which left Malta on Christmas Day accused of involvement in mass murder. Crewman was arrested by Greek authorities along with over 100 immigrants landed illegally in Greece. The immigrants said some 180 people died when the launch collided with a ship in the Malta-Sicily Channel. The launch had embarked the immigrants from the ship so that they could be landed in Sicily. A Maltese, Marcel Barbara, who was on the launch, is being sought by Greek police.
- Report recommends inquiry into Schools Maintenance Unit after finding evidence of widespread pilferage.

- Four people on hunger strike over Hilton hotel project write to Ombudsman seeking help. Strikers seek inquiry into how government land was passed to developers and say project is environmentally harmful.
- Nationalist Party leader Edward Fenech Adami meets Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi in Rome.
- Nationalist Party rejects government accusation that when party was in power it was able to show low unemployment figures because people were struck off unemployment register unjustly.
- Missing man found dead after being murdered and dumped in a well.
